Export designer

Turn a project, a whole portfolio or your strategy into a PowerPoint or PDF that is ready for the steering committee. Pick a preset, choose what goes in, and check every page before you save. Try it below with sample data. The pages on the right come from the same export engine as PPM Compass 360 version 1.6.

1Pick a preset 2Choose sections and look 3Check the preview, then export
…

Nothing cut off, nothing overlapping

Every section measures itself before it is placed. Long tables continue on the next page with the header repeated, or end with “+N more” if you prefer a short pack.

Presets for every meeting

One-pager, Steering pack and Full report come built in. Save your own, or publish one for the whole site, such as your “Steering Committee pack”.

Portfolio pack for portfolio managers

Portfolio health with key figures and the median health radar, a compact overview of all projects, one page per project and an appendix with upcoming milestones and top risks.

See what changed

Trend arrows next to each RAG rating show the change since the previous status report: better, worse. The health radar shows the previous report as a dotted line.

Editable in PowerPoint

Tables are real PowerPoint tables and the financial and trend charts are native charts, so you can still change a number or a title after the export.

Stays in your tenant

Exports are built in the browser and saved to your device. They contain no images, and the full project history goes to Excel when you need the raw data.

Sample data only: the names, projects and numbers on this page are made up. In PPM Compass 360 the dialog opens from the Export button on a project, from Reports → Export portfolio pack, from My Portfolio, and from Strategy → Executive story. · Release notes · Interactive demo · Product details
